scope: Read-only source/config contract review. No repository source edits, workflow generation, CI reruns, test changes, or external messages.

conclusion.reason: Pinned Velnor Actions 0.1.32 exposes no sparse-checkout or checkout-filter field in WorkflowConfig. checkout_step emits only persist-credentials. generator_validation=bootstrap selects generator validation mode; the public plan command prints a deterministic plan report. discovery.exclude affects detector/task discovery, not checkout contents. Current PR #38 generated Plan checkout has fetch-depth 0 and no sparse inputs.
conclusion.recommended_disposition: Keep generated full checkout until Velnor provides an upstream schema-validated sparse/filter-checkout capability, with tests proving closure over all Rust packages, build scripts, test fixtures, visual resources, and workflow generation inputs. Do not use discovery.exclude to remove checkout paths or hand-edit generated workflow files.

evidence.claim: WorkflowConfig denies unknown fields; generator_validation and checkout_lfs are the declared validation/checkout-related fields. No sparse-checkout or filter field exists in this struct.
checkout_step constructs the checkout input map with persist-credentials=false only.
discovery.exclude globs are applied before detectors; this is task discovery filtering, not checkout scoping.
CLI plan prints a deterministic plan report; generator validation bootstrap is a distinct setting, not a sparse-checkout mode.
Generator init template describes generator_validation=bootstrap as generator validation mode.

project_observation.local_docs_ci: docs/ci.md was absent from the inspected local design branch (rg reported no such file; docs file inventory also had no ci.md). This does not establish whether docs/ci.md exists at PR #38 or another ref.

pr38_sources.claim: Generated CI checkout uses the pinned actions/checkout revision and only persist-credentials=false; no sparse-checkout input is present.
Generated Plan job checks out with fetch-depth=0 and persist-credentials=false; no sparse-checkout input is present.
Plan job regenerates to a temporary directory and recursively diffs generated .github output against the checked-out .github tree.
PR #38 config sets generator_validation=bootstrap and consumer-v1; discovery.exclude is not a checkout list.

failure_classification.hosted_run_context: Parent-provided audit reports checkout of 95,193 files and frequent workflow cancellation before Plan/Actionlint/Rust jobs completed.
failure_classification.classification: Cancellation remains distinct from a skipped job, test failure, or pass. This source/config review does not establish the cause of cancellation or any Rust/test outcome.

safe_next_step: If checkout reduction remains required, request Velnor upstream support and validate the complete required-path closure and regenerated preview before changing .velnor/config.toml. Preserve current generated files and do not infer that exclusions are safe from file counts alone.
